steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates described Netwealth as an adviser-focused wealth platform, like a broker for advisers, offering access to listed markets and a long menu of unlisted options, with structures like trusts and super accounts being a major driver of usage.

In June 2026, Equity Mates said platforms like Netwealth offer a wild investment menu for advised clients, including private equity and unlisted funds alongside listed securities, highlighting the breadth of product access compared to standard retail brokers.

In February 2026, Equity Mates noted Netwealth’s retail platform existed but criticised its brokerage pricing for international trades as expensive at about $33, highlighting a product pain point on costs.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates discussed rising fee competition among platforms and questioned whether a race to the lowest fee could shift advisor flows toward Netwealth, noting numerous rivals also target the same advisers.

In October 2024, Equity Mates said Netwealth had about 8% market share and roughly $10 billion in net inflows over 12 months, benefiting from incumbents’ outflows and the long-term superannuation tailwind across a $1.1 trillion platform industry.

views.text: In August 2024, Equity Mates highlighted Netwealth’s strong unit economics, citing revenue of $207 million up 21% year on year, a 64% gross margin and $67 million profit, framing why the business model had looked attractive to investors.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In September 2026, Equity Mates reported that Netwealth acquired Paradino for $29 million, showing it was investing in AI-related capabilities within adviser workflows.

views.text: In October 2024, Equity Mates framed Netwealth’s long reinvestment runway as it disrupts incumbents and captures superannuation-driven growth, implying ongoing opportunities to deploy capital back into the business.

views.text: In June 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Netwealth struck a deal to deliver a broad set of alternative managers to clients via its platform, indicating investment to expand product access for advisers and their clients.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In October 2026, Equity Mates said Netwealth’s share price had roughly halved from its highs after years of being priced at high multiples, as growth in non-super flows moderated and industry fee pressure raised questions about margins.
In October 2024, Equity Mates noted Netwealth traded around 80 times earnings, observing that while the sector had a long runway, current multiples reflected high expectations.
